title: Influenza A(H1N1) examination for KIT visitors from overseas
contentHtml:
As Korea government is considering shutting down individual schools for a certain period if an infection is confirmed among staff or students, all KIT visitors just from abroad should be out of campus for 7 days and then are asked to go directly to KIT Influenza A Fever Consultation Center right away.

Thank you for your cooperation.


                             Center for International Programs(Ext. 7243)
